levels.surface: سالم بن عبد الله بن عمر

notes: ح gives two routes that meet at Salim. The glosses هو ابن سعيد and وهو الزهري are editor's glosses, left out: Muhammad is not merged with al-Zuhri (rule 9). Ibn Umar is written once after the last ح and is the shared tail. The text marks more routes than one, so read as two groups.
